title: feat(report): Redesign Report Designer Panel with Dashboard-Style UI & Address All Known Issues
body:
Complete redesign of the Report Designer Panel to match the Dashboard-style UI pattern, fixing the critical live preview linkage bug and adding all core interactive features from the issue checklist.

### Live Preview Fixes (`ReportView.tsx`)
- `mapReportForViewer` now **always regenerates sections** from current fields instead of only when `!mapped.sections` — fixes stale table columns after field changes
- Data fetch effect uses live `editSchema` with memoized dependency keys (`filtersKey`, `dataSourceKey`) so filter/objectName/limit changes trigger re-fetch
- Header title/description reads from `previewReport` instead of `reportData`
- `availableFields` derives from `editSchema` so changing objectName updates the field list
- Chart config from panel auto-generates chart section in preview

### Config Panel Enhancements (`ReportConfigPanel.tsx`)
- **Report type selector** — Tabular / Summary / Matrix (matrix planned)
- **Field picker with per-column aggregation** — multi-select checkboxes from `availableFields` with type indicators and per-column aggregation dropdown (Sum/Avg/Count/Min/Max)
- **Visual chart editor** — chart type selection (Bar/Line/Pie/Area/Donut/Scatter) + X-axis and Y-axis field mapping, no JSON editing required
- **Conditional formatting UI** — rule builder with field/operator/value + background color/text color picker; add/remove rules visually
- **Section/block manager** — add/remove/reorder report sections (Header, Summary, Table, Chart, Text) with up/down arrows and inline title editing
- **Undo/redo** wired from `useConfigDraft` to `ConfigPanelRenderer`
- New "Columns", "Chart", "Conditional Format", and "Sections" config sections

### Client-Side Grouping (`ReportViewer.tsx`)
- `groupData()` groups rows by first `groupBy` field, sorted by configured direction
- Table sections render group header rows with label and count
- `getCellStyle()` evaluates conditional formatting rules and applies inline `backgroundColor`/`color` styles to table cells

### Types (`reports.ts`)
- Added `ReportType = 'tabular' | 'summary' | 'matrix'` and `reportType` field to `ReportSchema`
- Added `conditionalFormatting` field to `ReportSchema` (field/operator/value/backgroundColor/textColor rules)
- Added `chartConfig` field to `ReportSchema` (chartType/xAxisField/yAxisFields)

### Tests
- 17 new tests covering: report type selector, field picker toggle, empty field state, undo/redo buttons, undo enable state, reportType in saved draft, per-column aggregation, chart config display, conditional formatting add/display, section manager display/add, grouped table rendering, ungrouped table rendering, conditional formatting cell styles
- All 66 tests pass (49 existing + 17 new), 0 CodeQL alerts

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>Redesign Report Designer Panel: Dashboard-Style UI & Address All Known Issues</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## Background
> 目前报表设计面板不够实用，主要问题包括：
> - 右侧配置面板的修改对左侧预览无实时响应（联动Bug）
> - 体验较为简陋，形同配置表单，而非真正的报告设计器
> - 缺少可视化字段选择、分组/聚合、拖拽排序、报表类型切换、条件格式、可视化图表编辑等核心交互功能
> - 配置项与数据未能实时联动，部分变动需手动保存、刷新、无法所见即所得
> 
> ## 参考对标
> - 设计与交互整体风格、操作体验应参考系统中已有的Dashboard配置面板（dashboard风格）
> - 主流低代码平台（Salesforce、ServiceNow、Power BI）的Report Builder功能（见比对分析）
> 
> ## 核心问题/改进点
> 1. **实时预览Bug修复**：右侧面板变动后，应立即刷新左侧报表
> 2. **字段/列选择**：需要可视化字段选择、聚合配置，并支持拖拽排序，类似Power BI/Salesforce的字段面板
> 3. **报表类型切换**：支持Tabular/Table、Summary、Matrix/Pivot等主流报表类型，并切换对应的分组与小计配置
> 4. **分组/聚合设置**：GroupBy/Sort要实现分组加聚合（不是单纯排序），可视化多级分组配置
> 5. **图表配置面板**：支持可视化选择图表类型与字段映射，不直接编辑JSON
> 6. **条件格式配置**：支持对字段值设置条件样式（如高亮、着色、标记）
> 7. **报表section/区域管理**：可视化添加、删除、拖动各报表区块（如header/footer/summary/table/chart），结构和内容动态可调整
> 8. **关联对象与数据源扩展**：objectName需支持跨对象、子表、lookup（树状）字段选择
> 9. **导出/打印/调度**：在增强设计器的同时保留现有导出、打印、调度等功能
> 10. **国际化与易用性**：汉化UI，按主流产品易用性设计（如快速填充，历史记录undo/redo，操作提示等）
> 
> ## 需求拆解与开发清单
> - [ ] **联动Bug修复**：右侧配置变动时自动触发数据和布局部分实时刷新，确保所见即所得
> - [ ] **字段/列选择器组件**（field-picker）：支持多选、拖拽排序、每列聚合方式配置
> - [ ] **报表类型/模式选择器**：Tabular, Summary, Matrix，可切换多种主要报表结构
> - [ ] **分组与聚合可视化设置**：多级GroupBy、聚合列拖拽、支持自定义分组字段
> - [ ] **图表编辑器优化**：图表类型切换+拖拽字段绑定，无需手写JSON
> - [ ] **条件格式UI**：规则可视化新建、规则编辑、为每字段添加多条高亮/格式规则
> - [ ] **Section/区块管理器**：支持管理header, detail, summary, chart等区块，区块顺序&内容可拖拽调整
> - [ ] **跨对象和多数据源支持**：objectName字段可选择主对象、关联表、子表
> - [ ] **UI国际化与易用性提升**：全UI中文/英文优化，增加快捷引导、提示、撤销重做等功能
> - [ ] **Dashboard风格一致性**：设计与交互风格与dashboard配置面板一致
> - [ ] **兼容导出/调度/打印**：调度/导出/打印等功能UI与设计器深度集成
> - [ ] **详细方案评审**：开发前整理设计方案、低保真原型，所有子任务经评审后细化拆分issue
> 
> > 详细比对分析及竞品参考见[相关行业分析](https://www.bing.com/search?q=How+do+mainstream+low-code+platforms+like+Salesforce%2C+ServiceNow%2C+Power+BI+handle+report+builder%2Fdesigner+features%3F+What+capabilities+do+they+typically+offer%3F)
